verdict.rationale: Langfuse is open source and self-hostable (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform), giving users full control and portability of their data, and explicitly supports data export via Blob Storage Export, Metrics API, SDK queries, and direct DB access on self-hosted deployments, all in open, non-proprietary formats. Community evidence confirms self-hosted users query the underlying DB directly, reinforcing true data ownership and exit capability.
